# CG-RES-009: Response value may now be null

A response value that was never null may now be null.

**Why it matters:** null was not a possible value before.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Responses](./#res) |
| Direction | response |
| Detects | `schema.nullabilityChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> {where} may now be null.
>
> Consumers that do not expect null may fail.
>
> **Fix:** Keep the value non-null, or release as a new major version.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: may now be null

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: [string, 'null']}}}}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. GET /x: response 200 (application/json) may now be null.

### Does not fire: 3.0 → 3.1 representation only

```diff
- openapi: 3.0.3
+ openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, nullable: true}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: [string, 'null']}}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.
